description: This file is a code-behind for a Dashboard page in an ASP.NET Web Forms application. It contains event handlers for button clicks that navigate to different pages within the online examination system.

classes.name: Dashboard
classes.description: Code-behind class for the Dashboard.aspx page, handling user navigation among different sections of the online exam system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, currently with no specific logic.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the home button click; currently no logic implemented.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the UserProfile.aspx page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the Leaderboard.aspx page.

methods.name: sExamB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the StartExam.aspx page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the LoginPage.aspx page, effectively logging out.
